panels.description: Caldera fabrication floor. Lina folds a membrane fragment into a transparent sleeve beside a technical bench. Keep the sleeve and her hands clear.
A reassignment notice flashes beside Lina's work station. Keep the notice unobstructed.
Lina hides the sleeve inside her stained technical coat while Alex approaches. Keep only Lina and Alex visible; leave upper space.
Lina hands Alex the sleeve and tears down the reassignment notice. Keep the handoff dominant and leave upper space.

items.speaker: LINA
items.text: I came before they came for it.
